newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Hondurans lynch 3 robbers - and their mother.
newsitem.headline: Hondurans lynch 3 robbers - and their mother.

text.p: A lynch mob in a remote Honduran village shot and hacked to death three robbers and then, for good measure, killed the robbers' mother, police said on Wednesday.
The incident occurred on Monday in the rural village of San Jose del Cacao, 120 miles (190 km) northwest of the capital Tegucigalpa, police spokesman Edgardo Zeron told Reuters by phone.

Zeron said the brothers were members of "a family of robbers" named Vega who had robbed two local men at gunpoint of $3,900 on Monday. "This angered the local community and they acted to defend them and took justice into their own hands," Zeron said, adding that virtually the whole population of the village took part in the lynching.
A crowd armed with pistols and machetes followed Rigoberto Vega to his mother's house and killed him, his brothers Santiago and Rene and his mother Dora Rodriguez, 43.
"The community killed them ... no one will name names," community leader Buenaventura Lemus told local reporters.
Zeron said no one had been arrested for the killings but investigations continue.
